scope.summary: Plan, implement, review, and run one Codex App fresh-task worktree experiment. Stage path rules exclude README.md. Only the correlated task worktree may transform README.md SHA256 70e242e898295dffaeb9a9723c5536edb96b5b6429e94fea274925a4a8b4e64e to d7844da1d65cabe3307959c6ac9a510e483bcdb99ad5070b280bdea0c33d575c, without commit. The bridge forces RUFF_NO_CACHE=true. No local Codex process or runtime integration.
non_goals: No modification or integration of app runtime, public API, product CLI, ToolRegistry, provider defaults, persistence, or the existing supervision kernel.
No local codex executable metadata probe, codex exec, provider subprocess, binary chmod or installation, inherited CODEX_HOME, credential proxy, VM, or container.
No RepoPilot runtime subagent or Codex App API/plugin/MCP implementation; the task tools remain an external development-workflow host channel.
No second task, second coding turn, retry, resume, replacement prompt, cohort rate, multi-Agent orchestration, background supervisor, or durable raw observation storage.
No stage-worktree README.md mutation; the task-worktree mutation permission is role-bound, exact-digest-bound, and does not widen stage-worktree allowed paths.
No semantic completion, authenticated source provenance, OS-level isolation, human approval, product acceptance, runtime integration, or Git delivery claim.
No modification of the original dirty worktree, archive, commit, merge, push, automatic task archive, or worktree deletion.
